title: Guy Banister, 544 Camp Street and the FBI's 'real X-Files' UFO collection
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Guy Banister, 544 Camp Street and the FBI's 'real X-Files' UFO collection, about 1963 at 544 Camp Street, New Orleans, Louisiana, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: >> And and he was operating before shooting him out of 554 Camp Street or 544 Camp Street in New Orleans. The guy that owned that building was Guy Banister, who was a very prominent FBI guy who ran the X-Files at the time, which was the UFO Collections, The Real X-Files, which is what the show is based on.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that before the 1963 killing of President Kennedy, Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of the shooting, was operating out of a building at 544 Camp Street in New Orleans. According to Michels, the building belonged to Guy Banister, a prominent FBI man who ran the bureau's UFO collection at the time, the real X-Files on which the television show was based. If true, it would link the Kennedy killing to the government's secret UFO files.
